settings.title: Settings
settings.dictionariesHint: Choose the dictionaries you use and the one a lookup starts with.
settings.oneOn: Keep at least one dictionary on.
settings.deckNameHint: Used when you export your saved words as an Anki deck.
settings.removeAfterExportHint: On: exported words leave your list. Off: they stay, marked as exported, and you choose to export all or only the new ones.
settings.freshDeckHint: Off: importing an exported deck again updates the cards you already have in Anki (keep the same deck name). On: every export is a separate deck, so Anki adds the cards again.
settings.reviewNewPerDayHint: How many words you have not reviewed yet appear in Review per 24 hours, from 0 to {{max}}. 0 shows no new words.
settings.reviewMaxPerDayHint: Review cards (due and learning) you see in Review per 24 hours, from 0 to {{max}}. 0 shows none.
settings.reviewAlgorithmHint: SM-2 is the classic schedule with fixed steps. FSRS predicts when you will forget each card and can be fitted to your own history. Switching keeps your progress; cards already scheduled keep their due date until you grade them next.
settings.desiredRetentionHint: FSRS: the chance to remember a card on the day it is due, from {{min}} to {{max}}. Higher means more reviews.
settings.fsrsDefault: Using the default parameters. Optimize after a few hundred reviews to fit them to you.
settings.fsrsTrained: Fitted to {{count}} of your reviews on {{date}}.
settings.fsrsApplied: Parameters updated from {{count}} reviews. Prediction error {{before}} → {{after}} (lower is better).
settings.storageHint: What you keep, against your limits. Exporting or deleting words frees content storage.
